[7:10PM] #AgegeMotorRoad #TrafficUpdate 

Motorists will experience good movement driving from Oshodi through Brown Junction, Arena, Ladipo, Shogunle, PWD, Airport bus stop, National, Ikeja overpass to Ajayi farm and on to Ile Zik.

Traffic back to through the same route to Oshodi is also in good shape.
